topic: Ransomware on your server: the 6-hour CERT-In clock — report within 6 hours of noticing (CERT-In Directions 28 Apr 2022, IT Act s.70B(6)); isolate, don't wipe, keep the logs; ignoring the directions: up to 1 year or ₹1 crore fine (s.70B(7), Jan Vishwas Act 2023); one-minute check: save CERT-In's toll-free 1800-11-4949
audience: CXOs, IT and security heads, owners of SMEs, schools and clinics with their own server (primary); accounts and admin teams
cover: A: YOUR FILES ARE LOCKED. / YOUR 6 HOURS START NOW. (alternatives B and C rendered for review)
note: Morning build, 27 Nov 2026. 35–45 s format (Reach fixes, 25 Nov 2026): frame 1 is the hook at full opacity, voice from 0.1 s, one law card + one number card, send line spoken and shown in the outro. The routine's stored prompt still says 90–120 s; CLAUDE.md's owner instruction of 25 Nov (35–45 s) wins.
